note: New entries are owner-only. Nick Hartman must state each exception. The default rule writes the letter sequence ie as y before dropping vowels, because he said that ie is usually a hard I. fried -> fryd is produced by that default rule and is not listed here. eye -> 'y stays, because the apostrophe annotates the vowel sound. Candidate exceptions not entered: field, piece, friend, and cie words such as science and ancient.
